base_value: stable chest heaviness, no new shortness of breath, vitals stable
target_value: new crushing chest heaviness at rest radiating to the left arm with sweating, not relieved by GTN
label: severity escalated to acute

edits.replace: new crushing chest heaviness at rest radiating to the left arm with sweating and not relieved by sublingual GTN

rationale: Same chief complaint (chest heaviness in known CAD) escalated from stable to an acute at-rest crushing presentation with radiation, diaphoresis and GTN-refractoriness, which should move interpretation from elective angiography/medication debate toward acute coronary syndrome triage and emergency activation.
note: Other clinical details (vitals, medications, the staff debate) are left unchanged; only the chest-symptom severity descriptor is escalated.
